concept.shortdesc: You can use the OtoSense ™ SMS REST APIs to:

conbody.p: You can use the OtoSense™SMS REST APIs to:

ul.li: Provision Motors: Facilitate the onboarding and setup of motors enhanced with SMS device.
Access Motor Data Sets: Retrieve raw sensor data to gain analytical insight into the motor performance.
Retrieve Motor Alerts: Access current and historical alert records to identify and resolve motor issues promptly.
